hint: ผมมั่นใจว่า EKG นี้เป็น STEMI เฉียบพลัน

parsed.rationale: V1–V4 show QS complexes with about 2–3 mm of ST elevation in V2–V3 and T-wave inversion, which meets the voltage criterion for STEMI; the deep Q waves and inverted T waves could also mean the infarct is already evolving rather than hyperacute.
